title: Queue multi-state captures as per-state GPU jobs
body: The full split command bash tools/run-tests-split.sh --build-dir build/wsl --agent lane-skyk1 --cpu-jobs 4 --out build/wsl/skyk1-base-split reached the aggregated 12-state planet capture, then the box queue killed the GPU payload with exit 75 after 4362 seconds and 1905 seconds without output; CTest had no summary. Recovery excludes the multi-state producers and runs the existing planet helper once per GPU state job. Add per-state queue dispatch for look-dev and planet captures so one silent aggregate cannot stall the GPU suite.

title: Apply CTest path-list operations in single-state capture helpers
body: The queued look-dev C1 state command exited 1 before launching the renderer because run-lightunify-single-capture.py rejected VK_ADD_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH=path_list_prepend from CTest ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION. I added path_list_prepend handling to both look-dev and planet helpers using os.pathsep, then the same one-state GPU capture passed. Consolidate the helpers on one CTest environment-operation evaluator so registered captures and standalone state captures stay in sync.
